title: Bringing Ridgecrest Advantage Coverage Ended for Non-Payment Back Into Force
content:
Where a good-cause determination restores a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment that was ended for non-payment, the enrollment is brought back into cover so that the member is covered again without a break, and the plan premium the member must pay for the months brought back is written on the enrollment as the balance owed.

Coverage terminated for non-payment is restored only once no other Medicare Advantage election for the member stands awaiting the transaction reply. While another Medicare Advantage election for that member is still standing awaiting the transaction reply, the terminated coverage is not restored.

The enrollment is returned to cover, the end date that had been recorded on it is taken off so the coverage period runs unbroken from its original start, the reason the coverage had ended is cleared, and the member's own recorded request is marked as carried out. Afterwards the member is covered again from the original start date and owes that balance.

### How the restoration is recorded

The representative does this on the plan's behalf. The tool `reinstate_terminated_coverage_2c8af1d8` is first unlocked and then called.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `advantage_enrollment_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Advantage enrollment being brought back, read from the member's enrollment record before the call | An identifier |
| `advantage_enrollment_request_id` | The reference number of the member's recorded request about that enrollment, read from their enrollment intake record before the call | An identifier |
| `restored_premium_balance` | The plan premium the member must pay for the coverage months brought back, in USD | A decimal number carried to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; zero is written as 0.0, and an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the enrollment reference number brought back, the original first day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD, and the plan premium balance now owed written to two decimal places in USD. The sentence is returned only once the enrollment has been returned to cover and the balance written on it, so its presence is what indicates the call completed.
